turns.q: Can I combine two separate orders into one shipment?
turns.replyTail:
• Just now
No — two separate orders cannot be combined into a single shipment once they’ve been placed. 
Each order is processed and fulfilled individually, and the system allows one shipping address per order. Because of this, separate orders remain separate shipments.
If you want multiple items shipped together, they need to be placed in a single order at checkout.
